coding_rna_duplex_and_motifs.model_scope: Single ViennaRNA minimum-energy structure at 37 C with standard unmodified-RNA parameters; not all conformations or a biological activation assay.

cryptic_orf_summary.note: The final CDS contains 96 alternative-frame stops and predicted stop-free runs up to 56 codons. These sequence counts do not measure leaky scanning or frameshifting. Alternative translation requires assessment with defined assay sensitivity; no experiment proves absolute absence.
cryptic_orf_summary.stored_strand_scope: Unique 8-11-mer sequences in the supplied stop-delimited ORF screen, assigned to the first enumerated strand (sense takes precedence if a sequence occurs on both). Antisense_IVT_byproduct_only queries are hypothetical reverse-complement IVT-byproduct sequences, not observed product impurities, translated antigens or measured presentation. These binding-prediction counts are separate from the homolog scan of admitted TARGET/JUNCTION queries. Threshold counts use the displayed rounded prediction ledger (nM: two decimals; ranks: four decimals), not new model inference.

innate_dsrna_interpretation: Stem lengths describe one predicted minimum-energy structure. The 30-bp reporting cutoff is an author-selected computational comparison, not a validated PKR or MDA5 activation boundary. Innate immune activation and manufacturing impurities have not been measured.

known_transcript_segment_duplex_and_moti.model_scope: Single ViennaRNA minimum-energy structure at 37 C with standard unmodified-RNA parameters; not all conformations or a biological activation assay.

mulroney_2024_frameshift_assessment.note: The configured UUUU and UUUC motifs are absent from the CDS. This does not establish translation fidelity or safety for any nucleotide chemistry; chemistry and translation products remain untested.
